description.value: This title presents a comprehensive survey of the visual identity of the world's major terrorist organizations, from al-Qaeda and the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine to the Tamil Tigers.

edition.title: Branding terror
edition.subtitle: the logotypes and iconography of insurgent groups and terrorist organizations
